summary: Aegon Ltd filed a Form 6-K on September 1, 2026, announcing the publication of the agenda for its Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for October 8, 2026, to seek shareholder approval for redomiciliation to the US, first disclosed in December 2025. The agenda and related materials, including a Shareholder Circular published August 26, detail proposed governance documents and an Omnibus Incentive Plan. The EGM will be held virtually. This is a routine meeting notice and shareholder circular, not a special-situation event. No deal terms apply.
